offering_description.value: Provides construction, engineering and maintenance services for utility, energy and renewable infrastructure. Customers include electric and gas utilities, pipeline operators, renewable developers, industrial companies and public agencies. Delivers work with its own field crews, equipment and engineers under fixed-price, unit-price and cost-plus contracts.

primary_services.value: utility power and gas distribution construction; pipeline and energy infrastructure construction; solar and renewable project construction; heavy civil and highway construction; maintenance and engineering services

customer_segment.value: B2B: electric and gas utilities, pipeline operators, renewable energy developers, industrial and refining companies; B2G: state transportation departments and municipalities for highway, bridge and water projects

end_markets.value: electric utilities; natural gas and pipelines; renewable energy; refining and petrochemical; transportation and water infrastructure

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price, unit-price and cost-plus construction and engineering contracts; service fees: master service agreements for ongoing maintenance, repair and replacement work

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys materials, equipment and subcontractor labor to build and maintain infrastructure for utilities, energy companies and public agencies

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with work in many US states

specialization.value: related lines: utility, energy and civil infrastructure construction sharing customers, crews and contract types

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bids and negotiated contracts with utilities, energy companies and agencies, plus master service agreements

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: construction safety (OSHA), environmental and pipeline rules (PHMSA), contractor licensing and public procurement requirements

notes: Website prim.com not verified; identified by name as Primoris Services Corp. Segment mix may have changed.
